description: Land Acquisition -Compensations for the land in Thelangapatha, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the statutory compensation deposit for a specific acquired land parcel (Nadungahakumbura), including its location, extent, and banking details for the deposit. The content focuses solely on land/property administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
